positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
•	Architected and developed an extensive codebase using LLMs to streamline legal processes in eDiscovery.
•	Devised and deployed an AI-driven document relevance predictor utilizing NLP techniques to guide users to critical content, enhancing information retrieval efficiency by over 80%.
•	Built an advanced search platform, enabling users to perform semantic search and question-and-answer interactions on custom collections of documents with a success rate exceeding 90% for natural language queries.
•	Created versatile document processing software that structures unstructured data from diverse file types.
•	Engineered robust features for file summarization and key entity extraction, improving data accessibility by 99%.
positions.insights: Skills: Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Large Language Models (LLM) · Python (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Project Management · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: CS106 Section Leader
positions.description:
•	Taught 15-person sections to enhance students’ understanding of CS concepts and problem-solving techniques.
•	Advised students during office hours by debugging code, clarifying concepts, and initiating problem-solving strategies. 
•	Graded students’ assignments and exams and held one-on-one interactive grading sessions with students.
positions.insights: Skills: Programming · Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Teaching · Computer Science · C++ · Algorithms · Communication

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Single-handedly designed and programmed three Android games to enhance the cognitive ability of patients with degenerative brain diseases. Utilized Java and Android Studio to craft engaging therapeutic experiences.
•	Developed a custom physics engine that simulates real-time complex object interactions and employs spatial partitioning algorithms to reduce required computational by over 50%.
•	Crafted image processing software that applies advanced smoothing techniques to correct 94% of noisy pixels.
•	Engineered robust and insightful user performance analytics that utilize data-driven methodologies to track, analyze, and visualize player progress in cognitive recall and reaction times across multiple sessions.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Android Development · Data Structures · Software Development · Project Management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: St Louis, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
•	Partnered with C-level executives (CEO, CTO, CFO) to identify and drive automation initiatives, leading to optimized processes that increased efficiency and reduced costs. 
•	Engineered and launched a robust Python-based web scraping tool hosted on AWS and interacting with a MySQL database to monitor updates to a supplier’s website and automatically modify Find Your Farmer’s website, cutting weekly manual workload by 10% and enhancing inventory management.
•	Created an intelligent inventory management application that automates supplier requests, streamlining communication, enhancing inventory control, and reducing 7.5% of the manual workload.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Python (Programming Language) · Data Structures · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Project Management · SQL

positions.title: Kentucky Youth Governor
positions.description: I led the Kentucky Youth Assembly and helped transition it over to a virtual format in order to continue teaching students about state government while keeping them safe from COVID-19.
